description: Classification of the charge category applied to this roaming event (e.g., AIRTIME for standard voice/data, ROAMING_SURCHARGE for additional roaming fees, INTERCONNECT for transit charges). Used for revenue assurance and settlement reconciliation.

reference: GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57) — ChargeInformation.chargeAmount; GSMA PRD BA.12 (IOT)

description: Volume of data transmitted from the network to the subscriber's device (downlink) during a GPRS/data session, measured in kilobytes. Null for non-data call event types.
Volume of data transmitted from the subscriber's device to the network (uplink) during a GPRS/data session, measured in kilobytes. Null for non-data call event types.
ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country for the called party in MOC voice events. Used for international traffic analysis and IOT tariff zone classification.
Discount applied to the gross charged amount for this roaming event as per the bilateral roaming agreement or special IOT discount arrangement. Reduces the net settlement obligation.
reference: GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57) — DiscountInformation; GSMA PRD BA.12

description: Duration of the voice call or data session in seconds as recorded by the visited network. Zero for instantaneous events (SMS/MMS). Used for IOT charge calculation and traffic analytics.

Exchange rate applied to convert the settlement currency amount to the home network's functional accounting currency at the time of TAP file processing. Used for financial reporting and revenue assurance reconciliation.
reference: GSMA PRD BA.12; ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Finance module

description: Flag set to True when this TAP record has been identified as potentially fraudulent by the fraud management system (e.g., IRSF, SIM cloning, abnormal roaming patterns). Triggers investigation workflow in the Revenue Assurance domain.
reference: GSMA PRD FS.11 (Fraud Information Gathering System); GSMA PRD IR.82; FCC Anti-Fraud Regulations

description: Charged amount converted to the home network operator's functional accounting currency using the exchange_rate. Used for financial reporting, EBITDA calculation, and MRR/revenue recognition in SAP S/4HANA.
reference: GSMA PRD BA.12; SAP S/4HANA Finance; TM Forum SID

business_glossary_term: Home Network Transferred Account Data Interchange Group (TADIG) Code
description: 5-character GSMA TADIG code identifying the home network operator (HPMN) to which the roaming subscriber belongs and to whom the TAP file is addressed for settlement.
reference: GSMA TADIG Code Registry; GSMA PRD TD.57; TM Forum SID

description: 15-digit unique identifier of the mobile device used by the roaming subscriber during this call event. Used for fraud detection, device analytics, and GSMA equipment identity register checks.

15-digit globally unique identifier assigned to the visiting subscriber's SIM card, comprising MCC+MNC+MSIN. Used to identify the roaming subscriber for settlement and fraud detection. Classified as restricted PII as it uniquely identifies an individual subscriber.
reference: 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57); GDPR Article 4

description: The specific IOT unit rate applied by the visited network to calculate the charged amount for this roaming event (e.g., rate per minute for voice, rate per KB for data). Sourced from the applicable IOT tariff table in effect at the time of service.

description: Unit of measure for the IOT rate applied to this roaming event (e.g., PER_MINUTE for voice calls, PER_KB or PER_MB for data sessions, PER_MESSAGE for SMS/MMS).
reference: GSMA PRD BA.12 (Inter-Operator Tariff); GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57)

description: UTC timestamp of the most recent modification to this TAP record in the Silver Layer (e.g., status change from PENDING to ACCEPTED, fraud flag update, RAP reference population). Supports audit trail and change tracking.
Location Area Code (LAC) or Tracking Area Code (TAC) identifying the geographic area within the visited network where the roaming subscriber was registered during this event.

business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
description: The E.164 telephone number of the visiting roaming subscriber. Used for call routing, subscriber identification, and customer-facing settlement records. Classified as restricted PII.
reference: ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57); GDPR Article 4

description: Radio access technology used by the visiting subscriber during this roaming event (e.g., 2G/GSM, 3G/UMTS, 4G LTE, 5G NR). Relevant for IOT tariff differentiation and network analytics.
reference: 3GPP TS 29.274; GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57); ETSI TS 132 250

business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Flag
description: Indicates whether this roaming CDR was also transmitted via the NRTRDE near-real-time roaming data exchange mechanism (within 4 hours of the call event) in addition to the standard TAP3 file. Used for fraud detection and real-time roaming cost monitoring.
reference: GSMA PRD IR.82 (NRTRDE); GSMA PRD FS.11

business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Transmission Timestamp
description: UTC timestamp when this CDR was transmitted via the NRTRDE mechanism to the home network. Null if nrtrde_flag is False. Used to verify compliance with the GSMA 4-hour NRTRDE transmission SLA.
reference: GSMA PRD IR.82 (NRTRDE); GSMA PRD FS.11

description: Indicates whether this TAP record represents a partial CDR (e.g., a long-duration data session split across multiple records by the visited network). True=partial record requiring reassembly; False=complete single record.

Current processing and settlement lifecycle status of this TAP roaming record. ACCEPTED=validated and accepted for settlement; REJECTED=failed TAP validation; DISPUTED=under inter-operator dispute; PENDING=awaiting validation; SETTLED=financially settled.
reference: GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57); GSMA PRD BA.12; TM Forum eTOM

description: GSMA-standard error/rejection code assigned when a TAP record fails validation (record_status = REJECTED). Codes are defined in GSMA TD.57 Annex and indicate the specific validation rule that was violated (e.g., missing mandatory field, invalid IMSI format, timestamp out of range).
reference: GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57) — Annex; GSMA PRD TD.60 (RAP)

description: Indicates the direction of roaming from the perspective of the home network operator. INBOUND=a subscriber from another network is roaming on our network (we are the VPMN); OUTBOUND=our subscriber is roaming on another network (we are the HPMN).
reference: GSMA PRD IR.21; TM Forum SID; GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57)

description: Sequential position of this CDR within its parent TAP3 file, as assigned by the visited network operator. Used for ordering, gap detection, and duplicate identification during TAP file processing.
3GPP teleservice or bearer service code identifying the specific service used during this roaming event (e.g., 11=telephony, 22=SMS, 41=data circuit async). Maps to the TAP3 BasicServiceUsed element.
UTC timestamp marking the exact moment the billable roaming event ended (call release for voice, session close for GPRS). Null for instantaneous events such as SMS/MMS.

UTC timestamp marking the exact moment the billable roaming event began (call answer time for voice, session start for GPRS, message submission for SMS/MMS). Principal business event time per TAP3 specification.
ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the inter-operator settlement charge for this TAP record is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determined by the bilateral roaming agreement.
reference: ISO 4217; GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57) — TapCurrency; GSMA PRD BA.12

description: Calendar month (YYYY-MM format) to which this TAP record is assigned for inter-operator financial settlement. Determines the billing cycle for IOT invoice generation between the visited and home network operators.

description: Operational system of record from which this TAP record was ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer (e.g., Amdocs Revenue Management TAP processing module, Comverse ONE, NRTRDE hub, or industry clearinghouse). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

Version of the GSMA TAP3 specification used to encode this roaming record (e.g., TAP3R12). Required for correct parsing, validation, and backward-compatibility handling during TAP file processing.

Tax or levy amount applicable to this roaming event as specified in the TAP record, if any. Included per TAP3 TaxInformation element where the visited network applies local taxation to wholesale charges.

description: Reference number of any active or historical inter-carrier dispute associated with this transit traffic record. Populated when settlement_status is 'disputed'. Used for dispute tracking and resolution in wholesale operations.

description: Total duration of the transit voice or signaling session in seconds. Used for per-second or per-minute IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) rate application and wholesale billing calculations. Null for non-voice traffic types.

description: Indicates whether this transit traffic record has been identified as potentially fraudulent (True) by fraud management systems, including IRSF (International Revenue Share Fraud) detection. Triggers investigation and potential blocking in the SOC (Security Operations Center).

description: The gross wholesale amount billed for this transit traffic record before any adjustments, discounts, or credits. Computed as transit_rate_applied multiplied by the applicable volume or duration. Used in Amdocs Revenue Management for invoice generation and settlement.

description: Indicates whether this CDR (Call Detail Record) was received after the standard TAP (Transferred Account Procedure) file submission deadline (True) or within the normal processing window (False). reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Domain; GSMA TAP (Transferred Account Procedure); Amdocs Revenue Management

business_glossary_term: NRTRDE (Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange) Sequence Number
description: Sequence number assigned to this record within the NRTRDE (Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange) data stream. Enables near-real-time fraud detection and roaming usage monitoring per GSMA PRD IR.71 requirements.

description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country from which the transit traffic originated. Used for international settlement rate determination, IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) zone classification, and regulatory reporting to FCC and ITU.

description: The calling line identity (CLI) or originating MSISDN/number from which the transit traffic was generated. description: The network routing number or trunk group identifier used to route this transit traffic through the Telecommunications network. Used for capacity planning, route optimization, and interconnect cost allocation.

description: Current lifecycle state of the transit traffic record within the wholesale financial settlement workflow. Drives downstream billing, dispute management, and revenue assurance processes in Amdocs Revenue Management.

description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country to which the transit traffic was destined. Used for international settlement rate determination, IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) zone classification, and regulatory reporting.

description: The called party number or terminating MSISDN/E.164 number to which the transit traffic was routed. description: Unique identifier for the IP address pool resource. Primary key for the pool entity.
Reference to the network device managing this pool (BNG, BRAS, leaf switch, DHCP server). Links pool to physical infrastructure.
Reference to parent pool if this is a sub-pool carved from a larger allocation. Enables hierarchical pool management and delegation.

Foreign key linking to location.service_territory. Business justification: IP address pools allocated by service territory for regional routing policies, CGNAT deployment, and network planning. Enables territory-based IP resource management and supports regional network arch
Strategy for assigning resources from this pool. Sequential for ordered assignment, random for load distribution, least-used for utilization balancing.
Current number of resources actively assigned from this pool. Updated in near-real-time as assignments and releases occur.
Type of entity that resources from this pool are assigned to. Subscriber for end-user accounts, CPE for customer equipment, network node for infrastructure.
Current number of unassigned resources available for allocation. Calculated as total_capacity minus assigned_count minus reserved_count.
Number of subscribers sharing each public IP address in CGNAT pools. Typical ratios range from 16:1 to 256:1 depending on service type and usage patterns.
CIDR notation for IP address pools (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16 for IPv4, 2001:db8::/32 for IPv6). Null for non-IP resource types.
Financial cost center code for charging pool-related expenses (IP address leasing fees, equipment costs). Used for chargeback and financial reporting.
Timestamp when this pool record was first created in the system. Part of standard audit trail for resource lifecycle tracking.

description: Default lease duration in hours for dynamic assignments from this pool. Applies to DHCP leases and temporary allocations. Null for static pools.
Date when this pool is scheduled to be retired or decommissioned. Null for pools with no planned end date.
Date when this pool becomes active and available for resource assignment. Used for planned pool activations and migrations.
Network encapsulation protocol used for this resource pool. 802.1Q for single VLAN tagging, QinQ for double tagging, VXLAN for overlay networks, EVPN for BGP-based VPN.
Geographic region or market where this pool is deployed (e.g., Northeast, California, EMEA). Used for regional resource planning and compliance.
Utilization percentage threshold that triggers capacity alerts. Typically 80-90% to allow time for pool expansion before depletion.
IP protocol version for address pools. IPv4 for legacy networks, IPv6 for modern deployments, dual-stack for transition scenarios.

Indicates whether assignments from this pool are subject to lawful intercept logging and monitoring requirements per regulatory mandates.
Indicates whether IP addresses in this pool are publicly routable on the internet (true) or private/RFC1918 addresses (false).
Timestamp of the most recent resource assignment from this pool. Used for activity tracking and idle pool identification.
Timestamp of the most recent resource release back to this pool. Used for churn analysis and capacity reclamation tracking.
Utilization percentage threshold below which the pool is considered underutilized. Used for resource optimization and consolidation decisions.
User ID or system identifier that last modified this pool record. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

description: Timestamp when this pool record was last modified. Updated whenever pool attributes, capacity, or configuration changes.
reference: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

Unique business identifier or code for the pool, used in operational systems and external references.
Human-readable name or label for the IP address pool, used for identification and operational reference.
Business unit, department, or team responsible for managing this pool. Used for accountability and operational ownership.
Current lifecycle status of the pool. Active pools are available for assignment, depleted pools have no available resources, quarantined pools are temporarily blocked.
Regulatory designation for this pool. Lawful intercept pools require logging for law enforcement, emergency services pools have priority routing requirements.

Maximum number of assignable resources in this pool. For IP pools, count of usable addresses; for VLAN pools, count of VLAN IDs.
Current utilization rate of the pool, calculated as (assigned_count / total_capacity) * 100. Used for capacity planning and threshold alerting.

High-level categorization of the dependency purpose. Commercial indicates bundle or pricing-driven relationships. Technical indicates technology stack or protocol dependencies. Regulatory indicates compliance-mandated relationships. Operational indicates process or workflow dependencies.

Current lifecycle status of the dependency relationship. Active indicates the dependency is currently in effect. Inactive indicates the dependency exists but is not currently enforced. Suspended indicates temporary hold. Pending indicates the dependency is being established. Terminated indicates the dependency has been permanently removed.

Classification of the dependency relationship between service instances. Composition indicates bundle/package relationships where parent contains children. Prerequisite indicates one service must exist before another can be activated. Peer indicates services that work together at the same level. Slice_component indicates 5G network slice composition. Wholesale_virtual indicates MVNO host-to-virtual service mapping. Technology_stack indicates layered technology dependencies.

Indicates the directionality of the dependency relationship. Parent_to_child means parent controls or contains child. Child_to_parent means child requires parent to function. Bidirectional means mutual dependency where both services depend on each other.

Date and time when the service dependency relationship ended or was terminated. Null indicates the dependency is currently active. Used for historical analysis and audit trails of service relationship changes.
Date and time when the service dependency relationship became active and enforceable. Used for temporal tracking of dependency lifecycle and historical analysis of service compositions.

External system identifier for this dependency relationship in the source OSS/BSS system. Used for reconciliation and integration with upstream systems. Enables bidirectional traceability between lakehouse and operational systems.

Defines how provisioning or lifecycle failures should be handled when they occur in the dependency chain. Rollback_all means any failure triggers rollback of all related services. One-time fee charged at the time of service activation for this rate plan. Denominated in currency_code. A value of 0 indicates no activation fee. Captured as a one-time charge in Amdocs Revenue Management.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — OneTimeCharge; Amdocs Revenue Management Billing Configuration

description: The frequency at which the recurring charge is applied and the billing cycle is closed. Drives invoice generation scheduling in Amdocs Revenue Management.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — BillingCycleSpecification; Amdocs Revenue Management Billing Configuration

description: The pricing model applied by the rating engine to calculate charges. 'flat' = fixed charge regardless of usage; 'tiered' = stepped rates at volume thresholds; 'volume' = single rate applied to total volume; 'event_based' = per-event charge; 'time_based' = charge per unit of time.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; 3GPP TS 32.240 — Charging Architecture

description: Minimum contractual commitment period in months associated with this rate plan (e.g., 12, 24, 36 months). A value of 0 indicates a month-to-month or no-commitment plan. Drives early termination fee (ETF) calculations.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — ContractTerm; FCC Consumer Protection Rules 47 CFR Part 64

description: The timestamp when this rate plan record was first created in the Amdocs Rating engine and ingested into the Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking per ISO/IEC 27001 information security requirements.
reference: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security Management; TM Forum SID GB922 — AuditTrail

description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts on this rate plan are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency billing environments and regulatory reporting.
reference: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; FCC Tariff Filing Requirements

description: Indicates whether this rate plan applies day-of-week pricing modifiers (e.g., weekend discount rates). When TRUE, the rating engine evaluates the CDR date against the configured weekend/weekday windows.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — DayOfWeekPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: Fixed monetary penalty charged to a subscriber who cancels the service before the contract_term_months expires. Denominated in currency_code. A value of 0 indicates no early termination fee. Used in churn management and collections workflows.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — PenaltyCharge; FCC Consumer Protection Rules 47 CFR Part 64; Ofcom General Conditions

description: The calendar date after which this rate plan is no longer valid for rating new events. Exclusive boundary. NULL indicates an open-ended plan with no scheduled termination. Used for plan deprecation and migration workflows.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimePeriod; IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers

description: The calendar date from which this rate plan becomes active and eligible for rating new subscriptions and usage events. Inclusive boundary. Used for temporal validity checks in the rating engine and revenue recognition.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimePeriod; IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers

description: Maximum data volume in megabytes beyond which the fair-use policy is triggered, resulting in speed throttling or additional charges. Distinct from the included_data_volume_mb allowance — this is the absolute ceiling before network management actions are applied. NULL indicates no fair-use cap.
reference: BEREC Net Neutrality Guidelines BoR(20)112; FCC Open Internet Order; TM Forum SID GB922 — PolicyCondition

description: The General Ledger account code in SAP S/4HANA to which revenue from this rate plan is posted. Enables financial reporting, EBITDA analysis, and MRR/ARPU reconciliation at the plan level.
reference: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922 — FinancialAccount

description: Data volume allowance included in the base recurring charge, expressed in megabytes (MB). A value of -1 or NULL indicates unlimited data. The rating engine deducts consumed data against this allowance before applying overage rates or fair-use policy throttling.
reference: 3GPP TS 32.251 — Packet Switched Charging; TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageVolumeProduct

description: Number of SMS messages included in the base recurring charge before overage rates apply. A value of -1 or NULL indicates unlimited SMS. Used by the rating engine for SMS CDR allowance tracking.
reference: 3GPP TS 32.240 — Charging Architecture; TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageVolumeProduct

description: Number of voice call minutes included in the rate plan's base recurring charge before overage rates apply. A value of -1 or NULL indicates unlimited voice. Used by the rating engine to track allowance consumption against CDRs.
reference: 3GPP TS 32.240 — Charging Architecture; TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageVolumeProduct

description: Indicates whether this rate plan is a promotional or limited-time offer. When TRUE, the plan may have an associated promotion expiry date and is tracked separately in ARPU and MRR reporting to distinguish promotional revenue from base revenue.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — PromotionSpecification; Amdocs Revenue Management Promotion Configuration

description: The timestamp when this rate plan record was last updated in the source system or Silver layer. Used for incremental ETL processing, change detection, and audit compliance.
reference: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security Management; TM Forum SID GB922 — AuditTrail

description: Commercial market segment for which this rate plan is designed. Drives eligibility rules in the product catalog and CRM. 'consumer' = individual retail customers; 'smb' = Small and Medium Business; 'enterprise' = large corporate accounts; 'wholesale' = carrier/MVNO partners; 'government' = public sector accounts.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — MarketSegment; eTOM 1.1.1 — Market Strategy

description: Multiplier applied to the base rate during off-peak hours when time_of_day_modifier_enabled is TRUE. A value of 0.5 means 50% discount during off-peak. NULL when time-of-day pricing is not enabled.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimeOfDayPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: The per-unit charge applied to usage that exceeds the included allowance. The unit of measure is defined by overage_unit_of_measure. For data, this is typically per MB or per GB; for voice, per minute; for SMS, per message. Denominated in currency_code.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageChargeSpecification; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: The unit of measure against which the overage_rate_per_unit is applied. Defines the granularity of overage billing (e.g., per MB for data, per minute for voice, per message for SMS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MB|GB|minute|second|message|event|kB — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — UnitOfMeasure; 3GPP TS 32.240 — Charging Architecture

description: The daily end time (HH:MM, 24-hour format) of the peak pricing window. Used by the rating engine to determine whether a CDR falls within peak or off-peak hours. NULL when time-of-day pricing is not enabled.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimeOfDayPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: Multiplier applied to the base rate during peak hours when time_of_day_modifier_enabled is TRUE. A value of 1.0 means no adjustment; 1.5 means 50% premium during peak. NULL when time-of-day pricing is not enabled.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimeOfDayPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: The daily start time (HH:MM, 24-hour format) of the peak pricing window. Used by the rating engine to determine whether a CDR falls within peak or off-peak hours. NULL when time-of-day pricing is not enabled.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimeOfDayPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: Current lifecycle state of the rate plan within the Amdocs Rating engine. Controls whether the plan is available for new subscriptions and active rating. 'draft' = under configuration; 'active' = live for rating; 'suspended' = temporarily halted; 'deprecated' = replaced by a newer plan; 'inactive' = decommissioned.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — LifecycleStatus; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: Billing modality of the rate plan. 'postpaid' = charges billed after consumption cycle; 'prepaid' = charges deducted from pre-loaded balance via Comverse ONE real-time rating; 'hybrid' = mixed prepaid/postpaid; 'wholesale' = inter-operator or MVNO wholesale pricing; 'mvno' = Mobile Virtual Network Operator resale pricing.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — BillingArrangement; GSMA PRD IR.21

description: The date on which the promotional pricing expires and the standard rate plan pricing takes effect. Applicable only when is_promotional is TRUE. NULL for non-promotional plans.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — PromotionSpecification; Amdocs Revenue Management Promotion Configuration

description: Method used to calculate partial-period charges when a subscription starts or ends mid-billing-cycle. 'daily' = charge proportional to days active; 'full_period' = charge full cycle regardless; 'none' = no proration applied.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — BillingCycleSpecification; Amdocs Revenue Management Billing Configuration; IFRS 15

description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the rate plan within the Amdocs Rating engine and is referenced by downstream billing, CDR processing, and invoice generation systems. Used as the business key for cross-system reconciliation.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: Detailed narrative description of the rate plan's pricing logic, applicable services, and commercial intent. Used by product managers, billing analysts, and regulatory reporting teams to understand the plan's scope.

Human-readable name of the rate plan as displayed in the Amdocs Rating engine configuration and referenced in billing statements and internal reporting (e.g., 'Unlimited 5G Consumer Postpaid', 'SMB Data Tier 3').

Number of pricing tiers (step thresholds) defined for this rate plan. A value of 1 indicates flat-rate pricing; values greater than 1 indicate tiered/stepped pricing where different rates apply at different usage volumes. Drives the rating engine's tier evaluation logic.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: Indicates whether usage events (CDRs) under this rate plan are rated in real-time (online charging via Comverse ONE for prepaid) or in batch mode (offline charging via Amdocs for postpaid), or a hybrid of both.
reference: 3GPP TS 32.240 — Charging Architecture; TM Forum SID GB922 — RatingFunction; Comverse ONE Real-Time Rating

description: The fixed periodic charge applied to a subscription on this rate plan per billing cycle (e.g., monthly base fee). Represents the Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) component at the plan level. Denominated in the currency specified by currency_code.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — RecurringCharge; Amdocs Revenue Management Billing Configuration

description: Code that maps this rate plan to the appropriate revenue recognition treatment in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Determines how recurring and one-time charges are recognized over the contract term per IFRS 15 / ASC 606 performance obligation rules.
reference: IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers; ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR)

description: Per-megabyte charge applied to data usage while roaming internationally, denominated in currency_code. Applies when roaming_enabled is TRUE and the subscriber is on a visited network. Used for IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) reconciliation.
reference: GSMA PRD IR.21; GSMA TAP3 — IOT; EU Roaming Regulation 2022/612; TM Forum SID GB922 — RoamingCharge

description: Indicates whether international roaming usage is permitted and rated under this rate plan. When FALSE, roaming CDRs are blocked or rated at a default barring rate. Relevant for NRTRDE/TAP roaming data exchange compliance.
reference: GSMA PRD IR.21 — Roaming Database; GSMA TAP3 — Transferred Account Procedure; 3GPP TS 22.011

description: Per-minute charge applied to voice calls while roaming internationally, denominated in currency_code. Applies when roaming_enabled is TRUE. Used for IOT reconciliation and NRTRDE reporting.
reference: GSMA PRD IR.21; GSMA TAP3 — IOT; EU Roaming Regulation 2022/612; TM Forum SID GB922 — RoamingCharge

description: The telecommunications service category to which this rate plan applies. Determines which usage event types (CDRs) are rated against this plan. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voice|data|sms|roaming|iot|iptv|voip|mms — promote to reference product]
reference: 3GPP TS 32.240 — Charging Architecture; TM Forum SID GB922 — ServiceSpecification

description: Identifier of the operational source system from which this rate plan record was extracted (e.g., 'AMDOCS_RATING', 'COMVERSE_ONE'). Supports data lineage, multi-source reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — DataSource; ISO/IEC 27001 — Data Provenance

description: Tax classification code assigned to this rate plan, used by the Amdocs tax engine to determine applicable tax rates (e.g., USF, VAT, GST, E911 surcharges). Maps to the tax jurisdiction configuration in the billing system.
reference: FCC Universal Service Fund (USF) Rules 47 CFR Part 54; ITU-T D.150 — Taxation of Telecommunications; ISO 20022 — Tax Information

description: The radio access or fixed-line network technology to which this rate plan applies. Used by the rating engine to apply technology-specific pricing tiers (e.g., 5G NR premium data rates vs LTE standard rates). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 2G|3G|4G_LTE|5G_NR|FTTH|GPON|ADSL|VDSL|WIFI — promote to reference product]
reference: 3GPP TS 22.261 — Service Requirements for 5G; ITU-T G.984 — GPON; ETSI TS 136 series — LTE

description: Per-unit charge applied to usage within the first pricing tier (from 0 to tier_threshold_1_mb). Denominated in currency_code per overage_unit_of_measure.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: Per-unit charge applied to usage within the second pricing tier (from tier_threshold_1_mb to tier_threshold_2_mb). Denominated in currency_code per overage_unit_of_measure. NULL if fewer than 2 tiers.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: Per-unit charge applied to usage beyond tier_threshold_2_mb (third tier and above). Denominated in currency_code per overage_unit_of_measure. NULL if fewer than 3 tiers.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: Usage volume threshold in MB at which the first pricing tier ends and the second tier begins. NULL if the plan has fewer than 2 tiers. Used by the Amdocs rating engine for stepped-rate calculation.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: Usage volume threshold in MB at which the second pricing tier ends and the third tier begins. NULL if the plan has fewer than 3 tiers.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: Indicates whether this rate plan applies time-of-day pricing modifiers (e.g., peak/off-peak rates). When TRUE, the rating engine evaluates the CDR timestamp against the defined peak/off-peak windows to apply the appropriate rate multiplier.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimeOfDayPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

description: Monotonically incrementing version counter for this rate plan record. Incremented each time the plan configuration is modified. Supports audit trail, change management, and point-in-time rating reconstruction for dispute resolution.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — VersionNumber; Amdocs Revenue Management Configuration Audit

description: Multiplier applied to the base rate on weekend days (Saturday and Sunday) when day_of_week_modifier_enabled is TRUE. A value of 0.0 means free weekend calls/data. NULL when day-of-week pricing is not enabled.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 — DayOfWeekPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

reference: 3GPP TS 32.297; 3GPP TS 38.401 (5G NR gNB); Ericsson Network Manager RAN

Foreign key linking to inventory.fiber_cable. Business justification: For wholesale/carrier billing, usage events on leased fiber must reference the cable segment. Required for wholesale fiber usage billing, capacity planning, and inter-carrier settlement.
Reference to the invoice on which this rated event charge appears. Populated after invoice generation; null for events not yet invoiced or for prepaid events settled via balance deduction.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 - Invoice; Amdocs Revenue Management Invoicing

Foreign key linking to enterprise.managed_service. Business justification: Usage events (data consumption, API calls, voice minutes) must link to managed service instances for capacity planning, SLA performance measurement, usage-based billing validation, and service-specifi

Reference to the original rated event record that this record supersedes or corrects. Populated for re-rated or reversed events to maintain the audit chain. Enables before/after comparison for revenue assurance and dispute resolution.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Event Correction; Amdocs Revenue Management; ISO/IEC 27001

description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Roaming events and wholesale usage must track originating/terminating partner network. Required for roaming event settlement, wholesale usage billing, inter-operator charging, and TAP/RAP file reconci

Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: Usage rating pipelines must be tracked for re-rating workflows, interconnect settlement reconciliation, and roaming dispute resolution. Enables identification of which rating engine run processed spec
Reference to the rate plan applied during rating of this event. Determines the pricing tiers, bundle allowances, and charging rules used to compute the charge amount.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 - Product Offering Price; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating

Foreign key linking to inventory.sim_stock. Business justification: Usage events (calls, SMS, data sessions) are generated by specific SIM cards. Rating engines need SIM-to-event linkage for fraud detection, roaming reconciliation, and SIM swap validation. Critical fo

Reference to the active subscriber service subscription (rate plan contract) under which this usage event is rated. Determines applicable rate plan, bundles, and allowances in Amdocs and Comverse ONE.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 - Service Subscription; 3GPP TS 32.240

The APN used by the subscriber for data sessions, identifying the packet data network gateway and service context (e.g., internet, enterprise VPN, IMS). Used for data service classification, QoS policy application, and DPI-based rating.
reference: 3GPP TS 23.003 APN; 3GPP TS 32.251 PS Charging; Amdocs Revenue Management

description: Indicates whether this rated event was charged against an included bundle allowance (True) or rated as an out-of-bundle/overage charge (False). Used to track bundle utilization, identify overage revenue, and support customer usage analytics.
reference: Amdocs Revenue Management Bundle Management; TM Forum SID GB922; Comverse ONE Balance Management

description: The destination number (B-party) dialed or messaged by the subscriber for voice calls and SMS events. Used for inter-operator settlement, fraud analysis, and regulatory lawful intercept compliance. Classified as confidential PII.
reference: 3GPP TS 32.250; ITU-T E.164; CALEA; ETSI LI Standards

description: The gross charge amount applied to this rated event before discounts and taxes, in the billing currency. Computed by the rating engine based on the applicable rate plan tier and rated volume/duration. Core financial field for revenue recognition and invoice line generation.
reference: Amdocs Revenue Management Rating; TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 15; ITU-T D.150

description: Classifies the nature of the charge associated with this rated event. 'usage' = consumption-based charge; 'recurring' = periodic subscription charge; 'one_time' = activation/setup fee; 'adjustment' = billing correction; 'reversal' = credit/reversal of a prior charge. Used for revenue categorization and GL posting.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 - Applied Customer Billing Rate; Amdocs Revenue Management; IFRS 15

description: The date and time when this rated event record was first persisted in the Databricks silver layer. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and pipeline monitoring. Distinct from rating_timestamp (when rated) and event_start_timestamp (when the event occurred).
reference: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail

description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the charge, discount, and tax amounts are expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Essential for multi-currency billing environments and inter-operator settlement.
reference: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ITU-T D.150; GSMA TAP3 IOT

description: The total discount amount applied to this rated event (promotional, loyalty, bundle, or contractual discounts) in the billing currency. Reduces the gross charge to arrive at the net charge. Used for discount analytics and revenue assurance.
reference: Amdocs Revenue Management Rating; TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 15

description: The reference number of the billing dispute or inter-operator dispute case associated with this rated event, if applicable. Populated when rating_status = 'disputed'. Links to the dispute management workflow in Amdocs or ServiceNow ITSM for resolution tracking.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Dispute; Amdocs Revenue Management; GSMA TAP3 Dispute

description: Indicates the origination direction of the usage event. MO (Mobile Originated) = subscriber initiated the call/session; MT (Mobile Terminated) = subscriber received the call/session. Relevant for voice and SMS rating and inter-operator settlement.
reference: 3GPP TS 32.250 CS Domain Charging; GSMA TAP3

description: The date and time when the usage event concluded (e.g., call release time, data session termination). Used to compute event duration and for billing cycle boundary determination.

Externally-known business identifier assigned by the rating engine or source OSS/BSS system to uniquely identify this rated event within a billing cycle or batch. Used for reconciliation, dispute resolution, and inter-operator settlement references.
reference: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA NRTRDE; TAP3 IOT

description: The date and time when the usage event began (e.g., call answer time, data session start, SMS submission time). This is the principal real-world event time used for billing cycle allocation, time-of-day rating, and CDR correlation.
reference: 3GPP TS 32.297; TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T Q.825

description: Classification of the usage event by service type. Drives rating logic selection and reporting segmentation. Examples: voice (MO/MT calls), SMS, data (packet sessions), roaming (visited network), content (OTT/IPTV), IoT (machine-to-machine). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voice|sms|data|roaming|content|iot|mms|video — promote to reference product]
reference: 3GPP TS 32.240 Charging Architecture; TM Forum SID GB922

reference: 3GPP TS 23.003; ITU-T E.212; GSMA TAP3; GSMA NRTRDE

description: The IMEI of the device used during this usage event. Used for device-level analytics, fraud detection (stolen device usage), and regulatory reporting. Classified as confidential device identifier.
reference: 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA IMEI Database; FCC Regulations
